description: Surfaced by the specled_-vnw cold verifier (2026-07-24): lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2131 still names the streaming-attribution sidecar (specled_attr_*.jsonl / specled_pgkill_* etc.) with System.unique_integer([:positive]) — the same VM-local scheme specled_-vnw fixed for command temp scripts (shipped 0.5.2, PR #15, 699a503). Cross-VM collision here would corrupt/steal attribution events between concurrent specled runs sharing tmp_dir rather than exit-127 a command, so impact is subtler (misattributed per-test coverage) but the fix is identical: OS pid + random entropy. Audit all remaining System.unique_integer-based temp paths in lib/ while at it (test-only usages are fine). Likely advances specled.verification.
title: Attribution sidecar temp-file naming: VM-local unique_integer (same collision class as specled_-vnw)
